title: Would You Rather?
description: A complex and ridiculous choice choosing minigame!
body:
![A banner displaying the text "Would You Rather?" A complex and ridiculous minigame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2814f242c63dac2b4babc08e7d19807add73739f.png) # Would You Rather? Would you rather is a unique and ridiculous minigame where players are prompted with different options, and forced to choose the seemingly less painful of the two. Every configured amount of time, all players will be presented with a "Would you Rather?" prompt. Each prompt contains two choices, with each choice containing a beneficial effect, and a detrimental effect. [Video Demo](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9c9fb934-8adc-4bb1-a74a-8bfeba48b617) ## Example Prompts
Example #1 ![WYR Example Prompt #1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0ccf3b1b24449ae9e1343c54cffd98faee9c194.png)
Example #2 ![WYR Prompt Example #2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca3976d7df64294e51485548d35c79bd0e9525b2.png)
Example #3 ![WYR Example Prompt #3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e04efa00f67611359ff82047ab3eefcfa069991.png)
## Getting Started 1. Install plugin on server 2. (Optional) Configure plugin values as shown below 3. Run `/wouldyourather start` to start the game ## Commands Click below to see the list of commands available in this plugin
Commands > `/wyr help` >
> Displays help information and a link to the documentation. > `/wyr start` >
> Starts a new Would You Rather game. > `/wyr stop` >
> Stops the current Would You Rather game. > `/wyr pause` >
> Pauses the active Would You Rather game. > `/wyr unpause` >
> Unpauses a paused Would You Rather game. > `/wyr removeeffect ` >
> Removes an active Would You Rather effect from a specified player. > `/wyr checkactiveeffects [player]` >
> Checks and lists all active Would You Rather effects on a specified player or yourself. > `/wyr sendnewprompt` >
> Forces the game to send a new prompt immediately. > `/wyr config` >
> Displays all configurable settings and their current values. > `/wyr config ` >
> Displays the value of a specific configuration key. > `/wyr config ` >
> Sets a configuration key to a new value. > `/wyr addspectator ` >
> Adds a player to the spectator list for the current or next game. > `/wyr removespectator ` >
> Removes a player from the spectator list. > `/wyr ExcludePlayerFromGettingPrompts ` >
> Makes it so a player will not recieve or be prompted to choose would you rather effects > `/wyr unexcludePlayerFromGettingPrompts ` >
> Make a player eligible again to receive would you rather prompts
## Configuration Configuration for the plugin is quite simple, and is done via in game commands opposed to a config file. ### Configuration Command Usage `/wyr config [config key] [config value]`
If the \[config key\] field is left blank, it will show all the available config options and their current values.
Config values can be updated on the fly during a game, and a changed value will be automatically updated without the need for stopping or restarting the game.
Config ## Configuration | Config Key | Description | Type | Default/Recomended | |--------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|--------------------| | `SetToDayOnGameStart` | Set to true to set the time to day when the game starts. | Boolean | `true` | | `ResetAdvancementsOnGameStart` | Set to true to reset every player's advancements when the starts. | Boolean | `true` | | `TeleportPlayersToWorldSpawnOnGameStart` | Set to true to teleport every player to the world spawn when the game starts. | Boolean | `true` | | `MinimumSecondsBeforeNewChoice` | The minimum number of seconds before a new Would You Rather prompt appears. A random value between this and `MaximumSecondsBeforeNewChoice` will be selected each cycle. | Integer | `60` | | `MaximumSecondsBeforeNewChoice` | The maximum number of seconds before a new "Would You Rather" prompt appears. Must be greater than or equal to `MinimumSecondsBeforeNewChoice`. | Integer | `180` | | `AllocatedSecondsForChoosingOption` | The amount of time players have to select their choice. | Integer | `25` | | `PreventMovingDuringChoiceSelection` | If true, players will be unable to move while selecting their choice | Boolean | `true` | | `ApplyDamageImmunityDuringChoiceSelection` | If true, players can't take damage while selecting their choice | Boolean | `true` | | `StartGameWithAChoicePrompt` | If true, players are given a Would You Rather prompt at the start of the game. | Boolean | `true` |
## Need Support? If you need help with anything related to the plugin, if you found a bug that you want to report, or if you have a suggestion of a feature that you want added, please refer the following. You can report issues and make suggestions on the [Github issue tracker](https://github.com/DogLoverPink/WouldYouRather/issues). Alternatively, if you want support, or another place for bug reports and suggestions, feel free to join my [discord server](https://discord.gg/KcGdBFUVZD)! [![A discord link, https://discord.gg/KcGdBFUVZD](https://dcbadge.limes.pink/api/server/https://discord.gg/KcGdBFUVZD)](https://discord.gg/KcGdBFUVZD) ## Want Even More Chaos? If you want even more features in this plugin, check out [MinigamesWithFriends](https://modrinth.com/project/minigames-with-friends). MinigamesWithFriends has all of the features of this plugin, plus more additional gamemodes that you can play aslong side WouldYouRather. Make sure to check it out! ## Acknowledgements I need to massively shout out [EightSidedSquare](https://www.youtube.com/c/EightSidedSquare) for coming up with the idea of this minigame. I loved watching [his showcase](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BIkMkv-UuiI) of his [WouldYouRather mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/wyr), and I thought it would be a perfect addition to have a similar concept implemented in this plugin.
